newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle steady at $63 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle steady at $63 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow to moderate in the Panhandle area Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady with last established trade.

Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 11,900 slaughter steers and 9,700 heifers; 44,600 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 20,100 formulated and 1,200 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 63.00. Pen Select, few Choice 1150 lbs 62.50. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 63.00.
Confirmed - 21,600 Week Ago - 30,600 Year Ago - None
Wk to date - 44,600 Week Ago - 52,000 Year Ago - 17,300
